# Recording run sheet

Recording is cheap; re-recording is expensive. Prepare so one session yields
everything.

## Before pressing record

- Rehearse every prompt once off camera; note which ones are slow.
- Reset state: delete rehearsal chats/connections so the take starts clean.
- One browser tab per piece of state you will show (each app or agent page).
- 1920×1080 window, 100% zoom, notifications off, personal tabs closed.
- Have prompts in a text file to paste; keep them short enough to type
  cleanly if you must type them on camera.

## During the take

- **Spoken cues**: say a short marker at each step ("prompt one", "adding
  the payments integration", "saved", "answer back"). They become timing markers for the
  edit and are never used as narration.
- **Holds**: stay 2–3 seconds on every result screen (saved dialog, returned
  answer, discovered card) so zooms and labels have room.
- **Mistakes**: say "redo" and repeat the step; don't stop recording.
- **Waits**: let long waits run; they are cut or sped up locally.
- Mention which agent/app is which at the start; it helps reading the cues.

## Take list template

| # | Screen | Action | Cue | Hold on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | App context | Show what the product knows | "context" | Answer, data source page |
| B | Configuration list | Show empty/existing list | "connections" | List |
| C | Receiving side | Show approval | "approved" | Approved row |
| D | Main chat | Prompt 1 | "prompt one" | Final summary |
| E | Add dialog | Fill, discover, save | "adding …" … "saved" | Discovered card, saved row |
| F | Main chat | Prompt 2 | "prompt two" … "answer back" | Tool card, answer |
| G | Other side | Incoming conversation | "their side" | Conversation |
| H | Add dialog | External system | "adding external" … "saved" | Card |
| I | Main chat | Prompt 3 | "prompt three" … "back" | Result |

## Prompts

- Short, natural, on-call voice. Put sanitizing rules in the product's
  configuration or memory, not in the on-camera prompt.
- Avoid typos; a typo in a recorded prompt must be blurred later.
- If the presenter records a video call, expect a camera tile and meeting
  chrome; crop and blur in local cutting.
